messages.author: Priya Lanthorn <priya.lanthorn@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Hi Ines,

Tidewater 1.8 is close. Today the harbour office sends us tide tables in local harbour time. Could your new tide software export them in UTC instead? Then we could drop the local-time format, which causes most of our daylight-saving bugs.

Best,
Priya

messages.author: Ines Calderwood <ines.calderwood@hollinmere.example.org>
messages.text:
Hi Priya,

Yes. Since August our tide software exports UTC, and we would rather use it. Please accept UTC tables only; we will stop sending the local-time files.

Ines

messages.author: Priya Lanthorn <priya.lanthorn@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Thank you, Ines. Then it is decided: from Tidewater 1.8 we accept tide tables in UTC only, and the local-time format is dropped. Tobias will make the loader refuse local-time files with a clear message.

Priya

messages.author: Lev Zarechny <lev.zarechny@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Hello Bertram,

From Beacon v2.3 we plan to send telemetry packets as CBOR instead of JSON. Does the RX-40 shore receiver with firmware 4.x parse CBOR? If not, what are our options?

Regards,
Lev Zarechny
Saltreed Harbourworks
